resources.string: Shifter uses your precise location while the app is open to check you in automatically when you arrive at your mission.
Location access denied. Without it you cannot be checked in automatically: ask your manager to check you in.
Location access denied: an approximate location cannot tell if you are at your mission. Allow the precise location to be checked in automatically.
Location access denied. To be checked in automatically, allow the precise location in the app settings.
Location is turned off. Turn it on to be checked in automatically.
